description: A report from sge_execd to sge_qmaster, e.g. a load report, a job report, ...

attributes.name: type
description: The type of the report, defined in source/libs/sgeobj/sge_report.h, e.g.

attributes.name: host
description: Hostname as it is seen by sender of report.

attributes.name: list
description: A list of report items, depending on the report type, e.g.
a list of load values (HL_Type) objects for load reports or
a list of job usage values (UA_Type) objects for job reports.

attributes.name: version
description: Used to report software version (the GDI version) of execd.
Only components with the same GDI version can communicate.

attributes.name: seqno
description: Used to recognize old reports sent by execd.

attributes.name: complete
description: Only used in job reports (NUM_REP_REPORT_JOB): true if the report list contains
the reports of all jobs on the host, false if it contains only the reports
which were flushed after job events.
A job report of an older sge_execd does not have this attribute.
